name: Julie Lippert
fact: Lippert, a Paducah junior, was WKU homecoming queen for 1983, crowned at the Morehead game by the 1982 queen Mary Beth DeCastro; Lambda Chi Alpha and Alpha Gamma Rho sponsored her candidacy. She was Administrative Vice-President of Associated Student Government the following year.

name: Shiela Marie Waninger
fact: Waninger was president of the Phi Mu chapter at Western in 1982-83, the year before she sat in the Congress as alternate for the College of Education. The Talisman describes her as a junior from Fulda, Indiana, and quotes her on the chapter’s recruiting: the volume spells her first name Shelia.

name: Alan Jackson
kind: SEARCHED, NOT FOUND - no portrait exists in reach
fact: Alan Lawrence Jackson sat for no class portrait in any volume that could hold him, and the two photographs the archive does reach both hide his face. The 1980 Talisman index gives him exactly two pages, 'Jackson, Alan Lawrence 124, 423'. Printed p. 423 is a 'Student teacher' feature whose caption reads that helping kids with their social studies at McNeill Elementary School is part of sophomore Alan Jackson's contribution to tutoring efforts for his fraternity: the frame holds two elementary-school children facing the camera and one figure in the foreground with the back of the head to the lens, which is the tutor, so his face is not in the picture. Printed p. 124 is the Halloween spread, and its caption on p. 125 names five studio subjects, Molly and Betsy Bogdan, Alan Jackson, Candy Bush and Kathleen Hancock. He is the only man of the five and the p. 124 right-hand frame is the only man on the page, so the identification is sound, but the whole point of the frame is a Hallowe'en skull mask and makeup covering the face. The 1981 index lists him with no page numbers at all, so he is in no photograph in that volume. The 1982 index gives him one page, 'Jackson, Alan Lawrence 266', the Kappa Alpha Psi pledging feature 'Step in line' on pp. 266-267, where he is named twice in the body and once in a caption as the owner of the apartment the picture was taken in, and is in none of the four photographs. He was a senior that year, so the 1982 volume is his last chance at a grid cell and he is not in it. Corroboration that this is the right man and not a namesake: the 1980 caption calls him a Tampa, Fla., sophomore, the 1982 body text a Plant City, Fla., senior (two towns twenty miles apart in the same county, and the class years line up), and he is a Kappa Alpha Psi brother, which fits the Chair of Minority Affairs. Note that the 1982 caption on p. 266 calls him a Paducah senior, contradicting its own body text on the same page.

name: Chris Millay
kind: SEARCHED, NOT FOUND - absent from every index that could hold him
fact: Checked at the exact alphabetical position on the page images of all three volumes that cover his two terms, not on an OCR miss. 1986 Talisman (covers 1985-86), printed index p. 375: the run is Milby, Melinda Alice 331 / Miles, Laura Lynn 310 / Millay, Beth Ann 132, 185, 346 / Miller, Audwin Glendell - no Chris Millay. 1987 Talisman (covers 1986-87), printed index p. 369: Millam, Glenn Everett 134-135 / Millay, Beth Ann 240 / Millay, Lori Ann 52 / Miller, Aubrey Douglas - no Chris Millay. 1988 Talisman (covers 1987-88, when he would have been a year older), index OCR'd from the page images because that volume's embedded text layer is unreadable noise: Miles, Andreae 145 / Millay, Beth 216-219, 238-239 / Millea, Scott 160 / Miller, Anna 355 - no Chris Millay. The Beth Ann Millay in all three is a distance runner from Guston and no relation the record shows. He is also in neither of the two Associated Student Government group photographs of the 1987 volume, printed p. 114, whose captions name all twenty-nine members, nor in the two of the 1986 volume, printed pp. 194-195, which name twenty-five. Since these indexes carry page numbers only for people actually pictured, absence from all three is a real negative and not a search failure.

name: Dwight Austin
kind: SEARCHED, NOT FOUND - absent from every index that could hold him
fact: Same method, same three volumes, read off the page images at the exact alphabetical position. 1986 Talisman, printed index p. 370: Ausenbaugh, Jim 77 / Auslander, Whitney Anne 277 / Austin, Alan Earl 338 / Austin, Robin Renae 352 / Austin, Samantha Andora 352 / Ayer, Jennifer Suzanne - no Dwight. 1987 Talisman, printed index p. 362: Auslander, Whitney Anne 14-17, 97, 116, 317 / Austin, Lee Ann 148 / Austin, Sherlan Salome 317 / Ayer, Jennifer Suzanne - no Dwight. 1988 Talisman, index OCR'd from the images: Ausenbaugh, Laura 347 / Austin, Alan 188 / Austin, Twana 347 / Ayer, Jennifer 132 - no Dwight. He is in neither of the two Associated Student Government group photographs in the 1987 volume, p. 114, nor the two in the 1986 volume, pp. 194-195. The one place he is named at all is the 1981 Talisman's full student-name index, 'Austin, Dwight Lea', which in that volume carries no page numbers, meaning he was enrolled but appeared in no photograph in the book. Note the 1980 and 1981 volumes index every enrolled student whether pictured or not, while 1986, 1987 and 1988 index only people who appear, so the two kinds of absence mean the same thing here.

name: METHOD: archive.org 1986 and 1987 Talismans, corrected leaf arithmetic
kind: correction to a recorded offset - costs a wasted download if you get it wrong
fact: Two separate numbers, and the earlier notes conflated them. (1) PAGE IMAGES: printed page = image leaf minus 3, for BOTH 1986 and 1987. Verified against printed folios: 1987 image leaf n117 is p. 114 (the Associated Student Government spread), n365 is p. 362, n372 is p. 369, n374 is p. 371; 1986 image leaf n195 is p. 192, n373 is p. 370, n374 is p. 371, n378 is p. 375, n379 is p. 376. The same rule holds for 1980: image leaf n426 is p. 423 and n427 is p. 424. (2) OCR TEXT STREAM: the leaf number that scripts/talisman.py computes by bisecting the hOCR page index runs THREE HIGHER than the image leaf on the 1987 item. Stream leaf 120 is image leaf 117. So from a search hit, image leaf = stream leaf minus 3 and printed page = stream leaf minus 6. Fetching the page at the stream's own leaf number lands three pages late, which is what made the 1987 index look as though A ran to R.

name: Mark Chesnut
kind: SEARCHED, NOT FOUND - indexed twice, both times to a table of names
fact: He is in the archive's reach and still has no face. The 1980 and 1981 Talisman name indexes list every enrolled student and print page numbers only against the pages where a person actually appears, so his entries are exhaustive. 1980 index: 'Chesnut, Mark Cameron 257', one page. Printed p. 257 is the intramural champions table, where he is named twice, at Racquetball (D) as 'Mark Chesnut and Mitch Gum (Sigma Alpha Epsilon)' and at Tennis (D) as 'Mark Chesnut (Sigma Alpha Epsilon)'. The only photograph on the page is an uncaptioned water polo frame. 1981 index: 'Chesnut, Mark Cameron 234', one page. Printed p. 234 is the same table a year on, Badminton (s) 'Mark Chestnut (Sigma Alpha Epsilon)' and Racquetball (d) 'Mark Chestnut/Mitch Gum', with an uncaptioned flag football photograph below it. Neither is a picture of him. He sat for no class portrait in either volume. He is not in the 1981 Sigma Alpha Epsilon chapter photograph on printed p. 314, whose caption names all thirty-eight members in five rows. And he is not in the 1982 volume at all: the only occurrences of the string in that book are Chestnut Street. The volumes print him both ways, Chesnut in the index and Chestnut in the 1981 table, and the 1980 text calls him 'a junior accounting major', which fits the man who was ASG Treasurer the following year.
